name: Miss roll
applies_to: Only when the target's Avoidance is above 0
why: No Avoidance on the target, no roll: Accuracy is dead weight there.
detail: A draw at or above the chance is a Miss and the hit deals nothing. Accuracy and Avoidance take battle % and flat bonuses; Accuracy % and Avoidance % take flat ones only.

name: ATK
why: Every battle ATK% buff shares one pool; a flat base line is scaled by it.
detail: Battle ATK = ⌊base × (1 + Σ ATK%) + Σ flat ATK⌋. Gear, runes and research build the base in managed code the client encrypts, so that part isn't read.

name: Skill coefficient
why: The hit's % of ATK from skill data: 155.2% is ×1.552.
detail: A plain float on each hit. That it is the skill coefficient is inferred from its name and place; the code that writes it wasn't read.

name: Final DMG
why: Its own bucket: +x% is worth x ÷ (1 + FDR) of damage.
detail: Battle bonuses add flat to the base rate; no % multiplier applies to it.

name: Enemy DEF
why: DEF never zeroes damage: at DEF = C_def a hit keeps 59%.
detail: DEF is floored at 0 first. The curve keeps 42% at 3 × C_def and 29% at 10 × C_def, so shred pays most against low-DEF targets. C_def is server data.

name: Element
expression: adv: 1 + EDB + C_inc · res: 1 ÷ (1 + EDR_t + C_dec)
applies_to: Advantage or resistance only; a neutral hit is ×1
why: Light vs Dark: the reduction wins whenever C_dec plus the boss's element RES is above 0.
detail: Fire beats Grass, Water beats Fire, Grass beats Water; Light and Dark beat each other, so a Light hit on Dark sets both and resistance wins. Element DMG adds; the target's element RES stacks as a screen.

name: Skill amp
why: One pool: +1 point is worth 1 ÷ (1 + total amp) of damage.
detail: Applies to every hit the damage system computes, not only skill hits. At 100% amp a point is +0.5% damage; at 122%, about +0.45%.

name: Enemy DMG RES
why: Reduction stacks as a screen: two 30% sources make 51%, not 60%.
detail: Battle DR = 1 − (1 − base) × Π(1 − bonus), clamped to 0–100% when buffs apply; the damage step applies it as is.

name: Boss DMG
why: Its own bucket: worth Δ ÷ (1 + Boss) on bosses, nothing on adds.
detail: Applied when the target carries the boss tag; every other target takes ×1.

name: Crit
expression: 1 + CDR × n · E = 1 + CDR × max(0, CR − CRES_t)
why: Linear past 100%: every 100% of crit rate is one more guaranteed tier.
detail: n = ⌊e⌋ tiers plus one more with probability e − ⌊e⌋, where e = CR − CRES_t. Per equal point, crit rate wins while CDR > e, crit DMG after.

name: Power penalty
applies_to: Hits on the Enemy side in Arena, stages, the Rift and daily dungeons; not Guild Conquest
why: Under recommended power you lose damage outside Conquest; Conquest has no penalty hook.
detail: A server tier table keyed by your power ÷ recommended (PvE) or enemy (PvP) power sets it. The side check is read; which modes wire it is inferred from the battle controllers.

name: Floor
why: No random spread: only the miss and crit-tier rolls vary a hit.
detail: Each hit's rolls are seeded from attacker and target, so damage is deterministic given the seeds.

name: Shields, then HP
why: Shields absorb first; an invincible target shows the number but loses no HP.
detail: Shields absorb in buffer order; the rest comes off HP, floored at 0. A map prop loses 1 HP per hit.
